system.description:
• Effect: Once per week, when reduced below half HP in combat witnessed by at least one ally or enemy, gain temporary HP equal to your Charisma modifier × half your Knight level.
  • 24th level: the temporary HP equal your Charisma modifier × your full Knight level, and you have Advantage on your first attack roll each round until the encounter ends

activities.name: Undying Reputation
activities.text: When reduced below half HP in witnessed combat, gain temporary HP equal to Charisma modifier times {13:half your Knight level, 24:your Knight level}. From 24th level you also have Advantage on your first attack each round.
